verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's documented interaction model is natural-language requests, typed or spoken. Users ask it to generate or edit images, request specific changes to documents, and delegate work to subagents. Voice can start tasks, check progress and change direction without typing. Community hands-on reports confirm day-to-day natural-language operation. Missing for 10: evidence that product settings and configuration (e.g. /fast, /memories, /goal, which use slash commands) can be changed through free-form natural language, and independent corroboration of the newer voice and Work task-orchestration features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Start work, check progress, or change direction without switching back to typing.
